method: built-in image generation; ImageMagick Lanczos export to requested 210x210

assets.usage_ru: Открытые равнины и холмы; все живые леса и редколесья, включая горные, кроме заболоченного леса.
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single reusable BASE BACKGROUND texture for a 2D hex-map game. Art direction: the elegant schematic cartographic terrain washes of Civilization V Strategic View, NOT its realistic 3D map. Original texture artwork, no copied assets. This is only the substrate underneath separately drawn conventional biome symbols. Output ONE square image, fully opaque and full bleed all the way to every edge, no hexagon shape or outline. It will be downsampled to exactly 210x210 pixels and clipped to hexes later. Flat orthographic surface, subdued matte hand-painted/cartographic finish, restrained near-uniform color with very soft small irregular tonal patches and delicate fine grain. Keep the field visually quiet with only low-contrast texture (roughly 5-8% local value variation), even brightness over the entire square, no focal point, no vignette, no edge border or dark perimeter, no center spotlight, no directional lighting, no perspective. All pixels represent the same material. No trees, plants, grass tufts, reeds, hills, mountains, rocks as objects, shorelines, islands, labels, letters, icons, grid, hex borders, UI, drop shadows, or decorative frame. Not photorealistic, not 3D, not a landscape scene.
Specific material: Muted fresh olive/sage-green ground wash, average color approximately #A5B879. Gently mottled herbaceous soil color only, no individually visible grass blades. Used underneath open plains, hills and all living forests including mountain forest. Pleasant readable mid-light green, ample contrast for dark cartographic symbols.

assets.usage_ru: Голые горы и все мёртвые леса/редколесья, включая холмистые и горные.
